metadata.evaluation_title: Independent Legal Review vs Frozen System Comparison
metadata.blocker_explanation: Independent external legal evaluation is strictly marked NOT_YET_EVALUABLE because no external practicing advocate, judicial clerk, or legal scholar has returned completed annotations under the Milestone 25 protocol. Developer-curated diagnostic labels are retained separately below for internal engineering reference, but must not be represented as external or independent legal ground truth.

supported_precision.definition: Proportion of claims predicted as supported that are independently affirmed as supported by the reviewer.
supported_precision.handling_of_ambiguous: Ambiguous claims predicted as supported count as false positives in the denominator.

supported_recall.definition: Proportion of independently affirmed supported claims that the system correctly predicted as supported.
supported_recall.handling_of_ambiguous: Ambiguous claims do not count in the gold supported denominator.

non_supported_false_acceptance_rate.definition: Proportion of non-supported claims (contradicted, partially supported, unsupported, or ambiguous) that leaked into the supported prediction class.
non_supported_false_acceptance_rate.handling_of_ambiguous: Ambiguous claims accepted as supported count strictly as false acceptances.

false_rejection_rate.definition: Proportion of genuine supported claims that were rejected, qualified, or unverified by the verifier.
false_rejection_rate.handling_of_ambiguous: Evaluated only over unequivocal supported gold claims.

ambiguity_rate.definition: Proportion of reviewed cases where the reviewer concluded that available context was legally indeterminate or permitted materially divergent interpretations.

context_request_rate.definition: Proportion of cases where the reviewer flagged that the 350-character excerpt was insufficient to determine the ratio decidendi without broader judgment context.
